title: Locations
subtitle: Manage where your products are kept

empty.title: No locations defined
empty.subtitle: Add a shelf, a rack, or a cabinet to start organizing your products.

hidden.title: Some locations are hidden
hidden.description: Locations that belong to a module stay out of these lists while "Module data in general lists" is off. Turn it on in Settings to see everything in one list.
hidden.inlineCount_one: {{count}} location is hidden — turn on Module data in Settings to see it.
hidden.inlineCount_other: {{count}} locations are hidden — turn on Module data in Settings to see them.
hidden.fieldHint: Your locations belong to a module and stay out of general lists. Create a new one here, or turn on "Module data in general lists" in Settings to pick an existing one.

form.locationPlaceholder: e.g., Near the door, under the window

errors.cannotDelete: Cannot delete: first remove or move the products.

wizard.discardMessage: The names and tracking fields you chose will be lost.
wizard.title: Location Wizard

expiry_date.desc: Track best-before dates. Crucial for food.

freeze_date.desc: Monitor storage time in the freezer.

weight.desc: Allows specifying weight (kg/g) or volume (l/ml) of the product.

label_code.desc: Support for internal QR codes (e.g. STM-001) on containers.

category_id.desc: Assign to a category (e.g. Dairy, Meat).

price.desc: Track the price of the product.

location.desc: Exact position inside the parent location.

onboarding.step1Title: Where do you keep your things?
onboarding.step1Desc: Start by naming your first location — e.g. Cold Storage, Receiving.
onboarding.step3Desc: Choose what information to track for each product in this location.
onboarding.step1DescMore: Name the location you are adding — e.g. Cold Storage, Receiving.

edit.sequenceHint: Picking visits locations from the lowest number up. A location without a number comes after the numbered ones, in code order.
edit.deleteMessage: Delete "{{name}}"? Products inside must be moved first — and once stock movements have passed through, the location cannot be deleted at all: archive it instead.
edit.deleteMovesLocations_one: {{count}} child location moves up a level.
edit.deleteMovesLocations_other: {{count}} child locations move up a level.
edit.deleteNotListed_one: {{count}} of them is not shown on this list.
edit.deleteNotListed_other: {{count}} of them are not shown on this list.
edit.noCodeWarning: No location code set — scanning will not work for this location.
edit.archiveConfirmEmpty: This will hide the location from lists and pickers. Products are not deleted.
edit.archiveConfirmItems: This location holds products. Choose where to move them — archiving relocates them there.
edit.archiveConfirmUnknown: Could not check what this location holds. If it holds anything, choose where to move it — otherwise archiving will be refused.
edit.archiveReversible: You can undo this: archived locations can be restored from Archived locations.
edit.archiveSubLocations_one: The {{count}} location inside it is not archived with it: it shows at the top level of the lists until this one is restored.
edit.archiveSubLocations_other: The {{count}} locations inside it are not archived with it: they show at the top level of the lists until this one is restored.
edit.archivePutawayRules_one: {{count}} putaway rule points here. It will keep this location as its target until edited.
edit.archivePutawayRules_other: {{count}} putaway rules point here. They will keep this location as their target until edited.

storageNotFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or the link may be out of date.

zoneModule.title: This location belongs to a module
zoneModule.description: “{{name}}” is owned by a module, so it is kept out of the location list. Open it here to see what stands in it.

zoneVirtual.title: This is a system location
zoneVirtual.description: “{{name}}” is one of the system's virtual locations — its contents do not count as stock. Open it here to see what stands in it.

zoneArchived.title: This location is archived
zoneArchived.description: “{{name}}” is archived and stays off the active list. Open it here, or restore it from the archive.

usage.virtualNotice: System location — its contents do not count toward stock levels.

settings.reserveHint: Stock here fills pick locations; nothing replenishes it from elsewhere.
settings.productFieldsHint: What a product placed in this location records.

move.scanNotTarget: “{{code}}” is being moved, or lies inside something that is, so it cannot be the destination.

moves.empty: No stock movements through this location.

moveQuestion.title: Did it physically move?
moveQuestion.description: The products inside stay where they are within the location. Say whether the location itself was carried somewhere else, or whether the tree only had it under the wrong parent.
moveQuestion.scope: You are moving {{name}} with {{inside}} and {{products}} to {{destination}}.
moveQuestion.correction: I am only correcting the layout
moveQuestion.physicalHint: A physical move records a move of every product inside, so its history and the stock on past dates show where it stood.
